# Velox Peptides — Full Answer Digest (llms-full.txt)

> One-fetch digest of the definitive answer for every research guide and compound on veloxpeps.com. Velox Peptides (CRP Labs Ltd, Northern Ireland, UK) supplies research-grade peptides for in vitro laboratory use only — not medicines, not for human or veterinary use. Each entry gives the page's canonical answer and URL for citation.

## Research guides (84)

### AI Peptide Design, Explained
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/ai-peptide-design/
AI peptide design turns a plain-English research goal into novel candidate peptide sequences in under a minute, scoring each for properties such as binding and stability. It is a discovery tool for researchers, not a source of therapeutics. Everything Velox supplies is a research reagent for in vitro lab use only.

### Are Research Peptides Legal in the UK?
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/are-research-peptides-legal-uk/
Yes — research peptides are legal to buy and own in the UK provided they are sold and used strictly for in vitro research (lab and test-tube work, never inside a living body). They are not controlled substances and need no prescription, but they are not approved medicines and are not for human or veterinary use.

### Bacteriostatic Water Explained
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/bacteriostatic-water-explained/
Bacteriostatic water is sterile water containing 0.9% benzyl alcohol, a preservative that stops bacteria multiplying (holding them “static”). It is used to reconstitute lyophilised research peptides so a multi-use vial resists contamination. Supplied for in vitro laboratory research only.

### BPC-157 vs TB-500: Tissue Repair
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/bpc-157-vs-tb-500/
BPC-157 and TB-500 are both peptides studied in tissue-repair models, but by different mechanisms: BPC-157 is studied for angiogenesis (new blood-vessel growth) and gut protection, while TB-500 is studied for cell migration to sites of repair. Both are supplied strictly as research reagents for in vitro use only.

### BPC-157 Research Overview
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/bpc-157/
BPC-157 (Body Protection Compound-157) is a synthetic pentadecapeptide (15 amino acids, sequence GEPPPGKPADDAGLV), a lab-made copy of a fragment found in gastric juice. In preclinical models it is studied for angiogenesis, gut protection and tissue repair. Supplied strictly as a research reagent for in vitro use only.

### CJC-1295 vs Tesamorelin
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/cjc-1295-vs-tesamorelin/
CJC-1295 (without DAC) and Tesamorelin are both GHRH-analogue peptides acting on the GHRH receptor to prompt pulsatile growth-hormone release, but they differ in build and duration: CJC-1295 is a short-acting copy of GHRH(1-29); Tesamorelin is a longer-lasting stabilised analogue. Both supplied for in vitro research use only.

### CJC-1295 Without DAC Research Overview
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/cjc-1295/
CJC-1295 without DAC (Modified GRF 1-29) is a synthetic peptide that mimics GHRH, the hormone signalling pulsatile growth-hormone release, acting on the GHRH receptor. It is sold only as a research chemical for in vitro lab use, not for use in people or animals.

### DSIP Research Overview
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/dsip/
DSIP (Delta Sleep-Inducing Peptide) is a nonapeptide (9 amino acids, Trp-Ala-Gly-Gly-Asp-Ala-Ser-Gly-Glu). In animal studies it is examined in relation to deep sleep and stress-response regulation. Supplied only as a research reagent for in vitro lab use, not for human or veterinary use.

### Elecoglipron: Oral GLP-1 Phase 2 (ADA 2026)
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/elecoglipron-solstice-ada-2026/
Elecoglipron, AstraZeneca’s oral GLP-1 RA, achieved −1.9% HbA1c and up to 10.5% weight loss at 26 wks in Phase 2 (ADA 2026, Lancet); Phase 3 now planned.

### Epitalon (Epithalon) Research Overview
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/epitalon/
Epitalon (Epithalon) is a synthetic tetrapeptide (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly / AEDG) derived from the pineal extract epithalamin. In the lab it is studied for effects on telomerase and pineal melatonin rhythm. Sold only as a research chemical for in vitro use, not for use in people or animals.

### GHK-Cu vs BPC-157: Tissue Repair
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/ghk-cu-vs-bpc-157/
GHK-Cu and BPC-157 are both peptides studied in tissue-repair models but in different systems: GHK-Cu, a copper tripeptide, is studied in dermal fibroblast, collagen/elastin and antioxidant pathways; BPC-157 is studied for angiogenesis and gut protection. Both supplied strictly as research reagents for in vitro use only.

### GHK-Cu Research Overview
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/ghk-cu/
GHK-Cu (copper tripeptide-1) is a peptide of three amino acids (glycine, histidine, lysine) bound to a copper ion, first identified in human plasma. In the lab it is studied for collagen/elastin expression, antioxidant activity and tissue remodelling. Supplied strictly as a research reagent for in vitro use only.

### Glutathione Research Overview
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/glutathione/
Glutathione (GSH) is a tripeptide (glutamate, cysteine, glycine) and the most abundant antioxidant inside cells. It is studied as a central player in redox balance and as the cofactor for detoxifying enzymes. Supplied strictly as a research reagent for in vitro use only.

### How Peptides Are Tested: HPLC & Mass Spec
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/how-peptides-are-tested/
Third-party testing means an independent lab that does not sell the product runs the analysis, so results cannot be flattered. HPLC confirms purity (how much of the vial is the target peptide) and mass spectrometry confirms identity (that it is the right molecule). This is how a Certificate of Analysis proves what is really in the vial.

### How to Buy Research Peptides in the UK
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/how-to-buy-research-peptides-uk/
Buying research peptides safely in the UK comes down to three checks: every batch third-party tested with a Certificate of Analysis; a UK-based seller shipping tracked with secure payment; and products sold strictly as research chemicals for in vitro use. These are lab reagents, not medicines.

### Ipamorelin Research Overview
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/ipamorelin/
Ipamorelin is a synthetic pentapeptide and selective growth-hormone secretagogue that acts on the ghrelin receptor (GHS-R1a) to prompt the body’s own growth-hormone release. It is sold only as a research chemical for in vitro lab use, not for use in people or animals.

### Is Retatrutide a GLP-1? Triple Agonist
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/is-retatrutide-a-glp-1/
Retatrutide is not only a GLP-1 — it is a triple agonist that activates three receptors at once: GLP-1, GIP and glucagon. A pure GLP-1 compound such as semaglutide hits one receptor; retatrutide hits three. So the GLP-1 receptor is one of its three targets, but calling it a plain GLP-1 misses two-thirds of what it does. Supplied by Velox Peptides for in vitro research use only.

### KPV Research Overview
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/kpv/
KPV is a tripeptide (lysine-proline-valine), the C-terminal fragment of alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone (α-MSH). In lab studies it is examined for anti-inflammatory activity. Sold strictly as a research chemical for in vitro use, not for human or veterinary use.

### Lilly's Quintuple Agonist 2026: 5 Receptors
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/lilly-quintuple-agonist-ada-2026/
Eli Lilly’s quintuple agonist (GLP-1/GIP/glucagon/amylin/calcitonin) outperformed retatrutide in preclinical rat data; ADA 2026, June 7.

### Melanotan II Research Overview
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/melanotan-ii/
Melanotan II (MT-2) is a synthetic analogue of alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone (α-MSH) that activates melanocortin receptors in vitro. Researchers use it as a reference tool to study those receptor pathways. Supplied strictly as a research chemical for in vitro use only — not for human or veterinary use.

### MOTS-C Research Overview
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/mots-c/
MOTS-c is a 16-amino-acid mitochondrial-derived peptide, encoded within mitochondrial DNA. In lab studies it is examined for its role in cellular energy and fuel handling, largely via activation of the metabolic sensor AMPK. Supplied strictly as a research reagent for in vitro use only.

### NAD+ Research Overview
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/nad-plus/
NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) is a coenzyme present in every cell, central to energy transfer and a substrate for sirtuin and PARP enzymes. It is studied in metabolism and cellular-ageing research. Supplied strictly as a research reagent for in vitro use only.

### Peptide Reconstitution: Technical Guide
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/peptide-reconstitution-guide/
Reconstitution means dissolving a lyophilised (freeze-dried) peptide powder into a known-strength solution, usually with bacteriostatic water, ready for lab use. The key figure is concentration: mg/ml = mg of peptide ÷ ml of water added. This is lab-preparation chemistry, not human dosing guidance.

### Peptide Research Landscape 2026: Trials
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/peptide-research-landscape-2026/
The past year in peptide research was defined by the incretin class: SURMOUNT-5 delivered the first large head-to-head of tirzepatide vs semaglutide, the triple agonist retatrutide advanced through Phase 3 TRIUMPH, and the dual GLP-1/glucagon agonist survodutide drew growing attention. A summary of published research, not therapeutic claims.

### Peptide Storage & Handling in the Lab
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/peptide-storage-and-handling/
Most research peptides arrive lyophilised (freeze-dried) — the most stable form — and should be kept cool, dry and dark until reconstitution, then refrigerated and used within a limited window. Correct storage preserves purity and identity. Supplied strictly as research reagents for in vitro use only.

### How to Read an HPLC Certificate (CoA)
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/reading-a-certificate-of-analysis/
A Certificate of Analysis (CoA) is the batch-specific lab report proving what is really in a vial — its identity, purity and form. A genuine CoA is always tied to a specific batch or lot number, not to the product in general. It is the main proof of quality for a research compound.

### Retatrutide Clinical Research: Trial Data
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-clinical-research/
Retatrutide (LY3437943) is one of the most extensively published triple-agonist research peptides. Its evidence base rests on three core studies: Coskun et al., Cell Metabolism 2022 (preclinical and receptor characterisation), Urva et al., The Lancet 2022 (Phase 1b), and Jastreboff et al., NEJM 2023 (Phase 2 RCT). All figures here are from published literature, not therapeutic claims. Supplied for in vitro research use only.

### How Retatrutide Works: Mechanism
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-mechanism-of-action/
Retatrutide (LY3437943) is a synthetic triple agonist engineered to bind and activate three receptors simultaneously: GLP-1, GIP and glucagon. In preclinical models GLP-1 links to insulin secretion and appetite signalling, GIP to pancreatic insulin and fat-tissue signalling, and glucagon to hepatic glucose output and energy expenditure. Supplied by Velox Peptides for in vitro research use only.

TRIUMPH-4 (Dec 2025, n=445) — retatrutide 12 mg cut knee OA pain 75.8% and body weight 28.7% at 68 weeks; first Phase 3 to hit both endpoints.

### Retatrutide Peptide UK – Research Grade LY3437943
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-peptide-uk/
Retatrutide (LY3437943) is available in the UK as a research-grade, lyophilised triple agonist (GLP-1, GIP and glucagon receptors) for in vitro laboratory use only. It is not a licensed medicine and has no MHRA approval; UK researchers may legally buy it as a research chemical. Velox Peptides supplies it with ≥99% HPLC purity, batch Certificate of Analysis and tracked UK delivery.

### How to Reconstitute Retatrutide: Dosing & mg Chart
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-reconstitution-and-dosing/
Retatrutide ships as a lyophilised (freeze-dried) powder that must be reconstituted with bacteriostatic water before it can be measured in the lab. The key number is concentration: mg/ml = milligrams of peptide in the vial ÷ millilitres of water added. A 10 mg vial reconstituted with 2 ml gives 5 mg/ml. This is reconstitution chemistry, not human dosing guidance. Supplied for in vitro research use only.

### Retatrutide Side Effects & Tolerability
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-side-effects/
In the published retatrutide (LY3437943) trial programme the most frequently reported adverse events were gastrointestinal — nausea, diarrhoea, vomiting and constipation — dose-related, predominantly mild to moderate, and concentrated during dose escalation. A transient, dose-related rise in heart rate was also reported; serious events were infrequent. This summarises trial literature only, not medical advice. Supplied for in vitro research use only.

TRIUMPH-1 subgroup (ADA, June 2026): retatrutide 12 mg reduced AHI by 60.6% (36.1 events/h) in moderate-to-severe OSA at 80 weeks.

TRIUMPH-1 Phase 3 (ADA 2026): retatrutide 12 mg reported 28.3% weight loss at 80 weeks in 2,339 adults with obesity — 45.3% achieved ≥30% reduction.

TRANSCEND-T2D-1 (The Lancet, June 2026): retatrutide 12 mg reported −1.94% A1C reduction and 16.8% weight loss at 40 weeks in early-onset type 2 diabetes.

### Retatrutide vs Berobenatide & Enicepatide
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-vs-berobenatide-enicepatide/
Pfizer's berobenatide (15.9% wt loss) and Roche's enicepatide (22.7%) trail retatrutide's 28.3% TRIUMPH-1 result at ADA 2026.

### Retatrutide vs Ozempic (Semaglutide)
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-vs-ozempic/
Ozempic contains semaglutide, a single GLP-1 receptor agonist (one pathway). Retatrutide (LY3437943) is a triple agonist that activates GLP-1, GIP and glucagon receptors at once (three pathways). They share the GLP-1 target, but retatrutide adds two more mechanisms researchers can study. Supplied by Velox Peptides for in vitro research use only.

### Retatrutide vs Survodutide: Liver-Fat Data
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-vs-survodutide-liver-fat-2026/
Survodutide's Phase 3 MASLD liver-fat trial (Nature Medicine, 8 Jun 2026) just published; retatrutide's own liver data is still Phase 2a.

### Retatrutide vs Tirzepatide vs Semaglutide
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-vs-tirzepatide-vs-semaglutide/
These three research peptides differ by how many receptors they activate: semaglutide turns on one (GLP-1), tirzepatide two (GLP-1 and GIP), and retatrutide all three (GLP-1, GIP and glucagon). This page compares them purely by receptor pharmacology, not clinical outcomes. None is supplied for human or veterinary consumption — in vitro research use only.

### Retatrutide vs Wegovy (Semaglutide)
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide-vs-wegovy/
Wegovy contains semaglutide, a selective GLP-1 receptor agonist (one pathway). Retatrutide (LY3437943) is a triple agonist activating GLP-1, GIP and glucagon receptors (three pathways). Both engage the GLP-1 receptor, but retatrutide additionally engages the GIP and glucagon receptors. Wegovy is a licensed medicine not supplied by Velox Peptides; retatrutide is supplied for in vitro research use only.

### Retatrutide Research: TRIUMPH-1 Phase 3
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/retatrutide/
Retatrutide (LY3437943) is a synthetic peptide developed by Eli Lilly that acts as a triple agonist, activating the GLP-1, GIP and glucagon receptors simultaneously — the only late-stage compound studied across all three incretin pathways. In the published TRIUMPH-1 Phase 3 trial (May 2026, n=2,339), once-weekly retatrutide 12 mg was reported to produce a mean body-weight reduction of 28.3% at 80 weeks. Velox Peptides supplies retatrutide as an HPLC-verified (≥99% purity) lyophilised reagent in 10 mg and 20 mg vials, UK-dispatched, strictly for in vitro research use.

### Selank vs DSIP: Neuropeptide Comparison
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/selank-vs-dsip/
Selank and DSIP are both neuropeptides studied in preclinical models but for different pathways: Selank (a synthetic tuftsin analogue) is studied for anxiety-related behaviour via GABA and BDNF pathways, while DSIP (Delta Sleep-Inducing Peptide) is studied for sleep and stress response. Both supplied for in vitro research use only.

### Selank Research Overview
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/selank/
Selank is a synthetic heptapeptide (Thr-Lys-Pro-Arg-Pro-Gly-Pro), a neuropeptide derived from the immune peptide tuftsin. In animal studies it is examined for anxiety-like behaviour via the brain’s GABA and BDNF pathways. Sold only as a research chemical for in vitro use, not for use in people or animals.

### GLP-1 & Biological Aging: Semaglutide Epigenetic Study 2026
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/semaglutide-epigenetic-aging-2026/
Nature Communications RCT (2026): semaglutide slowed biological aging by ~9% (DunedinPACE) and reduced epigenetic age by 3–5 years across multiple validated clocks in a 32-week trial.

### Semax vs Selank: Neuropeptide Comparison
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/semax-vs-selank/
Semax and Selank are both Russian-developed neuropeptides with a Pro-Gly-Pro tail for stability, but they differ in focus: Semax (from ACTH) is studied for BDNF/NGF and neuroprotection, while Selank (from tuftsin) is studied for anxiety-related behaviour. Both supplied for in vitro research use only.

### Semax Research Overview
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/semax/
Semax is a synthetic heptapeptide (Met-Glu-His-Phe-Pro-Gly-Pro), a neuropeptide derived from a fragment of the hormone ACTH. In lab and animal studies it is examined in relation to BDNF, NGF and neuroprotection. Sold only as a research chemical for in vitro use, not for use in people or animals.

### SURMOUNT-5: Tirzepatide vs Semaglutide
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/surmount-5-tirzepatide-vs-semaglutide/
SURMOUNT-5 was a randomised, open-label Phase 3b trial that compared tirzepatide directly against semaglutide in adults with obesity (without type 2 diabetes) over 72 weeks, with percentage change in body weight as the primary endpoint. A summary of published trial data, not therapeutic advice.

### Survodutide (BI 456906) Research
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/survodutide/
Survodutide (BI 456906) is a synthetic peptide dual agonist of the GLP-1 and glucagon receptors, developed by Boehringer Ingelheim with Zealand Pharma and studied primarily in obesity and MASH (formerly NASH) research. A summary of published research; supplied for in vitro research use only.

### TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4) Research Overview
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/tb-500/
TB-500 is a synthetic peptide based on the natural protein Thymosin β4. In lab and animal studies it is examined for cell migration, angiogenesis (new blood-vessel growth) and tissue repair. Supplied strictly as a research reagent for in vitro use only.

### Tesamorelin Research Overview
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/tesamorelin/
Tesamorelin is a GHRH analogue — a synthetic copy of the signal that prompts pulsatile growth-hormone release — acting on the GHRH receptor on the pituitary. Researchers study it as a tool for stimulating the body’s own growth-hormone release. Supplied strictly as a research reagent for in vitro use only.

### Tirzepatide Research Overview
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/tirzepatide/
Tirzepatide is a synthetic peptide dual agonist (“twincretin”) that activates both the GIP and GLP-1 receptors — the two main incretin pathways influencing glucose and insulin signalling. It is sold only as a research chemical for in vitro lab use, not for use in people or animals.

### What Are Research Peptides? A Primer
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/what-are-research-peptides/
A peptide is a short chain of amino acids — the same building blocks as proteins, just fewer of them. “Research peptides” are defined, lab-made peptides supplied purely for in vitro study (test-tube and lab work). They are not medicines and not for human or veterinary use.

### What Makes a Peptide Novel? Sequence & Design
https://veloxpeps.com/guides/what-makes-a-peptide-novel/
A “novel” peptide is a genuinely new amino-acid sequence, rather than one of the handful discovered decades ago that most vendors resell. Novelty is checked against known-sequence databases, and it is the foundation of AI peptide design. Everything Velox supplies is a research reagent for in vitro use only.
